cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a quiet memorial hall aboard a starship — kneeling on the ground; a windswept coastal bluff with a low grassy path and an empty kite-flying area — reading the changing wind before letting a simple diamond kite rise higher; an underground subway platform — holds a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw at chest height; a private orbital passenger cabin with an oval window and a fabric sleeping hammock — taking a quiet break while letting a folded paper star float gently between her hands; a chandelier ballroom at a masquerade — holds her keepsake in both hands in front of her; a neon-lit game arcade — standing; a hydroponic garden dome aboard a starship — standing; a Three Kingdoms festival street — kneeling on the ground; a rocky coast path with tide pools — carries a camera by its grip at her side; a castle courtyard rose garden around a stone fountain — folds a freshly washed sheet against her chest; a stage under a painted night sky of crystal stars — standing; a calligraphy classroom with low wooden desks — reads a bound bundle of bamboo slips; a stairwell landing with a tall window — holds her keepsake at chest height
